description: Opus R unit 7: Speed-changing items decide who sets the weather and terrain last. Power Anklet halves Pikachu (110 -> 55) below Chansey (70), so Pikachu's Rain Dance comes after Chansey's Sunny Day; Quick Powder doubles Ditto (68 -> 136) and Macho Brace halves Jolteon (150 -> 75), so Jolteon's Grassy Terrain comes after Ditto's Electric Terrain. Without the items: sun and Electric Terrain. Deterministic.
